visual_summary: A space battle unfolds around an asteroid cluster and a large artificial structure. In a cockpit, helmeted crew watch enemy ships peel away from a guarded target and move to defend their base. Hidden among the asteroids, many small endocraft lie in wait. Another panel shows the artificial planet or base being bombarded and exploding. In the final tier, a pilot calmly explains the tactic while reaching toward a control labeled for restricted destruction, preparing a powerful torpedo to keep the enemy occupied.
